description.message: Saves the current page or a link to Later on your own Cognoscimus server. The page is sent as you see it, so pages behind a login keep their text.

serverHint.message: The address of your Cognoscimus server, for example https://books.example.com. Saving asks for access to this server; the extension talks to no other site.

savedNoAccess.message: Saved, but without access to the server the extension cannot work. Save again and allow the access.

invalidServer.message: Enter an address that starts with https:// (or http://localhost).

connectionNeedsServer.message: Enter the server address first and allow access to it.

notConnected.message: Not connected. Connecting opens your server, where you confirm while signed in.

needsSetup.message: Enter the address of your server in the options first.

needsConnect.message: Connect the extension to your account to save pages.

detailsFailed.message: Note, collection and labels could not be saved.

saveFailed.message: The page could not be saved.
